summary: Biophytis S.A., a French Euronext Growth-listed clinical-stage biotech, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign issuer's current report) on November 2, 2026, carrying an October 30 press release on first-half 2026 results and strategy. Operating loss narrowed 39% to €-2.887m and net loss fell 38% to €-2.741m; net cash was €81m after the September capital increase, extending runway into Q1 2028. Disclosures cover the Phase 2 OBA obesity study and Hong Kong joint venture, not a special situation. Watch clinical milestones and financing needs.
